purpose: Measure existing PR35 sensitivity to actual removal of known corner pixels before deciding whether hidden-coordinate supervision is justified.
authorization: The user explicitly permits investigating hidden-corner predictions and reasonable implementation choices where the task leaves them unspecified. Estimates remain distinct from observed reference coordinates.

cohort.selection: Unique union of previously fixed interpolation and extrapolation target identities; no selection from new masked results. Four familiar, possibly correlated development scenes; not an independent test.

reference.meaning: Known physical coordinates observed in unmodified originals. Original boxes are fixed association anchors after masking, not readjudicated visible-face boxes.

masks.construction: Use original target box only: left[x0-.05w,x0+.25w], right[x1-.25w,x1+.05w], center[cx-.15w,cx+.15w], y[y0-6,y1+6]. Floor lower/ceil upper bounds and clip mask to image. Each altered image starts from the intact original.
masks.control: Center is a location control of approximately equal mask area, not a sham or guaranteed unaffected condition.
masks.coverage: Left/right must fully cover a radius-3px target neighborhood and leave the opposite point outside; center must leave both target points outside. Retain and report all collateral intersections.

metrics.association: Existing full-image confidence-ordered one-to-one same-class matching at IoU>=0.50. Do not use endpoint distance to select predictions.
metrics.denominators: All30targets per condition, including missing matches, suppressed endpoints and invalid points. Intact target observations derive from4sharedimagepredictions.
metrics.endpoints: Report covered side and opposite side separately: display availability, original-pixel error,5/10px success,confidence,pairedidentitychanges; preserve raw coords and scores.
metrics.extra_diagnostic: For unmatched targets, record best same-class box-IoU proposal as diagnostic only; never promote it into an official success.
metrics.visibility: Known reference coordinates remain immutable; covered coordinates have observed_in_masked_input=false in experiment metadata. Source v2 flags describe the original image only.

decision_limits: No training, checkpoint replacement, production threshold change, reference rewrite, or automatic hidden-label acceptance in this diagnostic.
Actual hidden-corner errors without independent coordinates remain unknown.
Mask artifacts, reference-derived placement, collateral occlusion and repeated scenes limit transfer to natural occlusion.
A supported occlusion-training hypothesis would need a separately fixed training-only protocol and explicit coordinate/visibility semantics; it is not automatically executed after this result.
The primary-reference coordinates for010:16and010:22 differ from the older context-study reference; compare only with fresh intact controls using this frozen reference.
